source_units: is a free psychoacoustic distance plug-in for pushing close sounds farther back without obvious reverb. It is designed for the moments where a source needs to feel a few meters farther away, but adding reverb or dulling it with EQ makes the mix sound artificial.
AAX / AU / VST3 for macOS 11 or later

Aim for subtle, mix-friendly depth control that can sit naturally inside a real mix.
